symptoms: Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) light active
stepByStepSolution: Verify tires are matching (including tread depth)
Verify car battery and charging system is to factory design.
technicalNotes:
As per TT 44-11-01, with the MK60EC1 ABS system, it may be required to Gerçekleştirin: Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  042 to help reset the TPMS.
